scope: One interactive Figure and nine static Figures; SVG only, with accessible HTML copy and controls.
hero_concept: A rail-mounted optical selector moves over one of three sample document trays; after arriving, that document and its matching grounded answer are shown together on the workstation readout.
truth_contract: Three authored, illustrative handbook entries map one-to-one to sample questions. This is a deterministic retrieval demonstration, not live AI, program availability or measured performance.

figures.mechanism: Three document trays with page stacks, a four-post gantry, two rails, a scanner carriage and optical head, a terminal case with a framed display and ventilation slots.
The retrieval workstation with its scanner and tool controls; a document is the evidence for an answer.
Open GPU rack: four vertical rails, four compute trays, vented heatsinks, network switch, power rail and connector bus.
Request bench: input queue tiles, a four-lane batch fixture, common processing head and a completed-output tray; grouping shares a processing step.
Camera mast watches a jointed robot arm over a sorting conveyor with objects and separate receiving bins.
Navigation test rig: tiled field, physical obstacles, a vehicle marker, goal fixture and feedback instrument.
Service cabinet: two service banks, a separate standby bank, input access gate and protected routing hardware.
Processor bench: a central compute package, separate memory packages, conductive bus tracks, connectors and a mounted instrument.
Capacity-planning console: three measured resource trays, allocation tokens, scale strips and a tradeoff readout.
Integration test bench: three connected module bays, a test fixture, three acceptance indicators and a delivery tray.

geometry: Common world scale; x/y on the bench and z up. Four-tone shading from Anatomy. Every solid recorded with its true shape and depth sorted. Moving carriage constrained to its supported rails.
verification: Geometry audit, line-end checks, desktop/390px captures in both themes, 4x junction crops, deterministic interaction checks, keyboard/touch, reduced motion, offscreen pause and no-JavaScript reading.
